job:
Product Designer

Beacon Labs is seeking an experienced Product Designer to lead the design of our consumer platform. You'll work across design, engineering, and product strategy to create seamless user experiences.

Must-have:
- 3+ years of professional product design experience
- Expert proficiency in Figma
- Demonstrated experience conducting user research and interpreting findings
- Experience building and maintaining design systems

Nice-to-have:
- Background in SaaS product design
- Experience with design handoff and developer collaboration
- Portfolio showing shipped consumer products
- Familiarity with design accessibility standards
